title: Railway RRB Section Controller Online Form 2026
vacancyDetails: Section Controller posts in Indian Railways as per latest RRB CEN for traffic / control cadre
qualification: Graduation / as specified in RRB Section Controller notification
ageLimit: As per RRB CEN for Section Controller
applicationFee: As per RRB application fee rules
selectionProcess: CBT → Psycho / further stages if any → Document Verification → Medical
documentsRequired: Educational certificates, photo ID, passport photos, signature, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.rrbapply.gov.in
2. Open Section Controller CEN apply online
3. Register and fill preferences for RRBs
4. Upload documents and pay fee
5. Submit before last date
shortDescription: Railway RRB Section Controller Online Form 2026 – apply on rrbapply.gov.in for control cadre posts.
content:
Railway Recruitment Boards recruit Section Controllers for train control operations on Indian Railways.

Eligible graduates should apply through rrbapply.gov.in when the CEN is active, complete CBT and medical standards as notified.
